name: theorum
description: A flat TypeScript agent kernel for typed profiles, deterministic turn execution, dynamic tools, provider adapters, guardrails, and host-injected traces.

scripts.coverage: rm -rf coverage && deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --coverage=coverage tests/ && deno coverage coverage --lcov --output=coverage/lcov.info && node scripts/lcov-to-istanbul.mjs
scripts.lint:fallow: npm run coverage && fallow audit && fallow health && fallow dupes && fallow dead-code
scripts.lint: npm run lint:biome && npm run lint:ast-grep && npm run lint:fallow
